name: Virtual Context
description: Integrates OpenClaw with virtual-context.com for unlimited memory, compressed LLM payloads, and memory retrieval tools.

vcKey.description: Virtual Context API key (sent as vckey query parameter)

baseUrl.description: VC REST API base URL (default: https://api.virtual-context.com)

providers.description: List of provider/model strings to activate for (e.g. ["openai-direct/gpt-5.4"]). Empty or omitted = all providers.

excludeAgents.description: Agent ids excluded from Virtual Context entirely: no prepare, no ingest, no VC commands for their sessions. Matched case-insensitively against the agent id in the session key. Unlike the providers allowlist, exclusion holds across model switches and fallbacks. Empty or omitted = no agents excluded.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging of REST API calls, payloads, and responses. Default: false.

modelCallCapture.description: Optional bounded, local capture of complete OpenClaw llm_input/llm_output hook payloads. Captures contain conversation content and are written mode 0600.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of capture files retained.

agentKeyFiles.description: Map of agent id -> absolute path to a file containing that agent's VC key. That agent's traffic is sent with that key, and therefore resolves to that key's tenant; every other agent uses vcKey. The config names a FILE so no key material is stored here. Invalid or unreadable entries are skipped with a log and fall back to vcKey.

convIdentity.description: Conversation identity mode: 'session' keys VC conversations by the rotating OpenClaw session UUID (legacy); 'stable' keys durable chat scopes by their session key so memory survives session rotation.

outboundIdCapture.description: Capture the bot's OWN outbound message ids so the engine can recognise its own text when a member quote-replies it. Requires convIdentity="stable": ids can only be bound to a conversation there, and nothing is captured otherwise.

mode.description: "off" registers no hook and changes no byte on the wire. "observe" captures and reports with no network effect. "carry" adds the ids to the ingest body and, when latePath is set, to a durable delta queue delivered by its own non-blocking worker.

latePath.description: REST path for ids witnessed after their turn's ingest already completed. Without it there is no durable backstop and late ids are lost (counted, never silently). Must be agreed with the engine before enabling.

conversationGroups.description: Map of group session key -> member session keys. Every member shares the group key's stable VC conversation. Requires convIdentity="stable". Exact stable keys are supported; a terminal agent:<agent>:discord:channel:* wildcard is accepted only when OpenClaw binds that agent to an allowlisted Discord account with exactly one explicit guild, and the group key names that guild. Discord DMs and group DMs remain separate.

ingestRetry.description: Retry an ingest the receiver rejects with conversation_lifecycle_busy. Default off: this covers no naturally-occurring failure mode observed to date, and the failures that do occur are timeouts, which are not safe to retry.

enabled.description: Arm the retry. Leave unset unless the receiver is known to be returning conversation_lifecycle_busy.

agentActorIds.description: The agent's own platform actor ids, keyed by platform (e.g. {"discord": "1485..."}). Supplied to the engine so it can tell its own quoted output from a member's. A WRONG value suppresses a real person's quoted words, so it is cross-checked at boot against other plugins' botUserId entries and disabled on any disagreement.
